written: 2026-11-10, before any E1 trace or ranking result exists
data: 129 public tasks (tasks.jsonl). Gold = non-test functions edited by `patch` (execgraph.gold), restricted to nodes of the task's competition graph.

split.rule: per repo, sort ids by sha256('e1-split-v1:'+id); first round(40*n_repo/129) are tune

levels.S: static graph + AST graph + embedding edges + issue text
levels.R: S + traces of the 3 existing test files nearest the issue by BM25 (no test_patch used)
levels.F: S + trace of the task's real failing tests after test_patch (upper bound; uses gold tests)

methods: ablations: rwg_ppr without runtime edges, without semantic edges, without text seeds

metric.primary: hit@5 over eval tasks with >=1 gold node in the graph

tuning: rwg_ppr parameters (w_runtime, w_sem, sem_k, reverse, alpha, mix, exact_bonus) chosen by grid search on the tune split only, frozen and committed before scoring the eval split. Any change after the eval split is scored is reported as exploratory, with every configuration tried.

hypotheses.H1: rwg_ppr(R) > text on eval hit@5 (paired bootstrap, 95% CI of difference excludes 0)
hypotheses.H2: rwg_ppr(R) > rwg_ppr(S) on eval hit@5 (runtime evidence from existing tests helps)
hypotheses.H3: rwg_ppr(F) >= max(ochiai(F), prfl(F)) on eval hit@5 (text seeding adds to spectrum methods)
hypotheses.H4: rwg_ppr(S) > text on eval hit@5 (the static graph walk alone helps)
hypotheses.D1: descriptive: share of executed repo->repo call edges (both endpoints graph nodes) absent from the competition graph and from the AST graph, with causes
hypotheses.D2: descriptive: call-path distance from innermost crash frame to nearest gold function (F)

exclusions: tasks whose F trace is missing are excluded from F-level rows only, and counted. Feature tasks and module-level-only edits are reported separately, not dropped.
